item.title: Executive Turntable: Lawyer Who Advised on BMG-Concord Deal Joins Nixon Peabody; THE·TEAM Adds Teammates
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our latest update from the music business world. Today, we're talking about some exciting news from global law firm Nixon Peabody. They've just added a new partner and head of their music practice, and we're here to tell you all about it.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: "Meet Matt Finkelstein, the newest partner at Nixon Peabody. Finkelstein joins from ArentFox Schiff and brings with him a wealth of experience in handling transactions and copyright matters for some of the biggest names in the music industry. We're talking record labels, music publishers, artists, songwriters, and even concert venues.
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "Finkelstein's credentials are impressive. He recently advised BMG in its merger with Concord, and has worked on major catalog and royalty stream deals for the likes of the Beatles, Fleetwood Mac, and even the Rolling Stones. In fact, he represented Mick Jagger and Keith Richards in a high-profile advocacy effort for artist royalty rights just last year.
[Soft music continues]
Host: "According to Nic Mayne, co-leader of Nixon Peabody's entertainment and sports team, Finkelstein is 'one of the most recognized transactional lawyers in the music industry'. His arrival at the firm is a big deal, and is expected to deepen Nixon Peabody's music capabilities and enhance their service to clients across the music ecosystem.
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "And Finkelstein isn't the only new face at Nixon Peabody. The firm has also brought on Los Angeles associate Taylor J. Coley, who joins the music practice and corporate group. These hires are part of a larger growth trajectory for the firm's entertainment and sports team, which has added several new members earlier this year.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to our update from the music business world. We'll be back with more news and updates soon."
